claim: Archaeological survey around Anuradhapura identifies Buddhist monasteries as one of the most persistent and prominent site classes in the urban-period hinterland, with later scholarship emphasizing their economic and administrative roles alongside royal and local institutions.
bounded_by: Monasteries were major nodes in a heterogeneous landscape; the claim does not assign them exclusive control over the countryside or all irrigation.
notes: Useful bridge between the museum map's monastery distribution and the project's existing work on Mahavihara/Abhayagiri/Jetavana.
